description: Which one-command add-ons (email, errors, ...) a branch has and whether each is live, with a proof record {kind, id, at}. Pass `slot` for one. Never returns a credential. Scope: projects:read.

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

slot.description: One capability, e.g. email. Optional: all of them.
